title: Implement Request Body Parsing for JSON and URL-Encoded Data
description: This feature will enable yantraverse to handle JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, allowing developers to easily parse and access request data. It will improve performance and solve real problems for users who need to handle complex request data. By adding this feature, yantraverse will become a more robust and production-ready framework
acceptance: Request body parsing works correctly for JSON and URL-encoded data, and error handling is in place for invalid request bodies
reason: This feature is essential for a production-ready framework, as it will enable developers to handle a wide range of request data and improve the overall performance and reliability of their applications
